name: r4-cuda-ldg256-token-r2
author: solx-loop
description: One CTA per (token, stream) makes the weight tile constant and the weight address a function of threadIdx only. The real lever is that each of the 384 threads owns two rows (heads h and h+24), so it issues two 256-bit DRAM loads up front. At 40 regs and 4 CTAs/SM that is about 96 KB of reads in flight per SM, against the parent's 64 KB.
